newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria's Credit Express Bank raises capital.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria's Credit Express Bank raises capital.

text.p: Bulgaria's private Credit Express Bank raised share capital to 2.2 billion levs from 800 million levs through a rights issue, the bank said in a statement.

"The shareholders' meeting on Thursday approved a capital rise to 2.2 billion levs through a rights issue to meet central bank minimum capital requirements for a full banking licence," the statement said.
The issue was distributed among the current shareholders in proportion to their stakes. Payments into the capital should be completed by March 15.
The shareholders also authorised the bank's board of directors to raise the capital further to comply with expected upward revisions of central bank minimum capital requirements.
Under current central bank requirements local commercial banks should have 1.4 billion levs capital for a domestic licence and 2.2 billion levs for a full one by March 31.
The bank's board of directors is headed by Slavka Ivanova. Its members are Pavlina Anachkova, Chavdar Darzhikov, Stefan Stefanov and state-owned insurance company Bulstrad as a legal entity.
Bulstrad replaced the Motor Insurance Company (MIC) as a board member after MIC was merged into Bulstrad last year. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
